headline: The 1,000-euro benefit is in the new 2027 Budget Law
summary: The government is revising the 2027 Budget Law, focusing on a new Irpef income tax cut for the middle class and tax incentives for under-35s. A 1,000-euro benefit is reported in the draft.
why: Italy's budget sets fiscal deficit targets and bond issuance needs, which influence Italian government bond yields and investor confidence in the euro-area's third-largest economy.
